recognize_zh: 血液抹片中除了典型小淋巴球與兩個破碎的污斑細胞（smudge cells）外，還混有較大、帶明顯核仁的前淋巴球（上方）與細胞質較多、核偏心的大型淋巴球，細胞形態不一，符合 CLL 混合細胞型（mixed cell type / atypical CLL）。
features: Heterogeneous lymphoid population rather than uniform small lymphocytes
Larger cell with moderate pale-blue cytoplasm, round nucleus, and a visible central nucleolus consistent with a prolymphocyte (top)
Medium-sized lymphoid cell with more abundant blue cytoplasm and slightly irregular nucleus (lower left)
Small mature lymphocyte with condensed clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm (bottom right)
Two smudge cells with disrupted streaky chromatin
Red cells largely normocytic with occasional stomatocytic/drying artifact
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a lymphocytosis composed of a heterogeneous population, including small mature lymphocytes with clumped chromatin, larger lymphoid cells with more abundant pale-blue cytoplasm, and a cell with a prominent central nucleolus consistent with a prolymphocyte. Smudge cells are present. Red cells show no significant abnormality apart from minor drying artifact. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia of mixed cell type (atypical CLL); the proportion of prolymphocytes should be quantified (10-55%) and a CLL immunophenotype (CD5+, CD23+, CD200+, dim sIg) confirmed, with exclusion of mantle cell lymphoma by cyclin D1 or t(11;14).

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma shows medium cells with irregular or cleaved nuclei and is CD23-negative/CD200-negative with cyclin D1 and SOX11 expression and t(11;14).
Prolymphocytic leukemia requires more than 55% prolymphocytes with a monomorphic nucleolated population, whereas here small mature lymphocytes and smudge cells predominate.
SMZL cells show short polar villous projections and plasmacytoid features, and are usually CD5-negative and CD23-negative.
Richter transformation shows sheets of large cells with high proliferation in tissue, rather than scattered larger cells in a CLL blood background.
